notes.title: LastSoul_0.6.7 Update
notes.content:
* Added Japanese language (Machine translation)
* Added Chinese language (Machine translation)
* Fixed bugs in Russian and English
* Updated and expanded tutorial
* Fixed tooltip about control buttons in the game
* Towers of tier 1 and 2 have increased the initial level of immersion, now it will be easier to defeat them at the initial stages of the game
* Volume slider no longer covers the background
* Fixed crash when using dodge
* Slightly increased the speed of Unleashed Souls
* Fixed a bug where level 4 towers could become immortal
* Changed damage coefficients when colliding with towers, now you will not lose all power at the slightest mistake
